metadata.title: Union Eyes Phase 1A user-surface census
metadata.scope: Phase 1A only; static source census; no runtime journeys; no Phase 1B or remediation
limitations: Page labels derive partly from historical static census and route/layout cues; they do not establish authorization.
Action scan is broad markup candidate extraction, not a runtime reachability graph; handlers and business effects are not fully traced.
No route behavior, API authorization, data ownership, or audit coverage was assessed.
Historical persona labels are treated as candidates unless corroborated by the current role path allowlist or explicit public-route evidence.

The capability registry reconciliation records each existing registry row, ownedBy paths, registry state and owner-file presence; it does not equate keyword similarity with a verified product capability.
Derived capability records are grouped UI-label candidates, not an exhaustive or verified product capability universe.
